title: Von A nach B / Clear axes

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Constrain movement to readable directions because clear axes help viewers anticipate change.
strategic_value: A simple red field crossing the frame can express DB’s direct and decisive motion principle.
demonstration: A red rectangular field moves across the dark stage on vertical and horizontal axes.
practical_value: Use this pattern to compare axis-led movement with diagonal or arbitrary paths.

content_islands.name: Moving field
content_islands.spec: Let a straight-edged red rectangle traverse the dark field along one axis at a time.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Von A nach B guidance connects reduction, straight directions and decisive movement.
reference_purposes.Application: The animated field demonstrates the stated axis-led pattern.
